def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The full-length 2 stripe is the boundary; move the colored object
    # against it, then mark the far side with an 8 stripe.
    if any(all(v == 2 for v in row) for row in grid):
        axis = 0
        line = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (2, grid[0][0])]
        if not cells:
            return grid
        lo, hi = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
        if hi < line:
            shift = line - 1 - hi
            side = lo + shift - 1
        else:
            shift = line + 1 - lo
            side = hi + shift + 1
        out = [row[:] for row in grid]
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c] = grid[0][0]
        for r,c in cells: out[r+shift][c] = grid[r][c]
        if 0 <= side < h:
            out[side] = [8]*w
        return out
    if any(all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)):
        axis = 1
        line = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)))
        bg = grid[0][0]
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (2, bg)]
        if not cells:
            return grid
        lo, hi = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
        if hi < line:
            shift = line - 1 - hi
            side = lo + shift - 1
        else:
            shift = line + 1 - lo
            side = hi + shift + 1
        out = [row[:] for row in grid]
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c+shift] = grid[r][c]
        if 0 <= side < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][side] = 8
        return out
    return grid

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=2).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # identify full-width or full-height 2 marker
    hr=next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v==2 for v in row)),None)
    vc=next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))),None)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if hr is not None:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
        lo=min(r for r,c in pts); hi=max(r for r,c in pts)
        shift=(hr+1-lo) if lo>hr else (hr-1-hi)
        # clear then move object, stripe immediately beyond moved object on far side
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in pts: out[r+shift][c]=grid[r][c]
        side=(hi+shift+1) if lo>hr else (lo+shift-1)
        if 0<=side<h: out[side]=[8]*w
        return out
    if vc is not None:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
        lo=min(c for r,c in pts); hi=max(c for r,c in pts)
        shift=(vc+1-lo) if lo>vc else (vc-1-hi)
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c+shift]=grid[r][c]
        side=(hi+shift+1) if lo>vc else (lo+shift-1)
        if 0<=side<w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][side]=8
        return out
    return out
